## Appearance

Thorne possesses light, curly hair. Her eyes are also noted to be captivating.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Nell Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041)_

## Personality

Miss Thorne is an intelligent and compassionate young lady. She has a talent for capturing and keeping the love of her students.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIV. Miss Thorne and Her Pupils Get Up a Concert P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)_

## History

Miss Thorne served as a schoolteacher who maintained absolute discipline without ever striking a student. When [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) returned to school following an injury, Miss Thorne guided her studies and later offered to include her in a special class preparing students for the Regent's entrance exam. At the end of that term, she reassured her students that she would return the following year, after which she continued guiding Nell's preparation for the examination through the autumn.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIV. Miss Thorne and Her Pupils Get Up a Concert P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXIV. ## Relationships

### [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/nell-harcourt--thorne.md)

Thorne serves as [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) Harcourt's schoolteacher, guiding her academic progress and reassuring her at the end of the term that she would return to teach the following year. Seeing Nell's potential, Thorne offers her a place in a special preparatory class for the Regent's entrance exam to help her train as a future teacher. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) works hard under Thorne's instruction, preparing for the examination with the teacher's steady guidance.
